purpose: The ordinary Episode loop and controlled return boundary, reduced to what the one system Episode type (episode_runtime/episode_type.py) uses: asynchronous only, one Episode at a time, no pending, detached, suspended, redelivered or goal-revising work, and one end of an Episode (its controller's stop). Added: unit outcomes and updates in the trace, view and resume; the typed forms. The Episode type, journal, custody and every application behaviour live in episode_runtime and are not part of this library.

details: Contribution, UnitRecord, UnitView and ResumeUnit carry the unit's outcome; a child unit's ResumeUnit and Contribution also carry its EpisodeUpdate, which EpisodeUpdate.as_record/from_record restore exactly, so EpisodeView.updates, child_reports and outcomes are the same after a resume.

Episode carries parent_input and records (a read-only reader supplied by the builder); EpisodeView exposes parent_input, outcomes, records, with_unit(outcome); Episode.view_of(record) gives the closed view.
ChildEpisodeUnit has one projection callback (ChildProjection: report, outcome, controller_input) instead of separate report and credit callbacks; the callback is called once per child.
JsonRecord (a closed JSON record) lives here.

Deleted: asynchronous-ownership machinery (DeferredUnit, PendingAction, ClosedChildUnit, start_async, allow_suspension, owned-child waiting, pending acquisition/observation/return bookkeeping, failed-source accounting hooks bind_execution_context, suspension_changed, record_execution_failure), report redelivery (ReportRedelivery, ReportDeliveryError, receive_failure, delivery_contract, delivery_failures), goal revision (GoalProposal, GoalPreview, GoalState, EpochMutation, next_epoch, goal_result, Context.transition), synchronous run, run_unit_async, resume_owned_accounting_async, leaves(), model_inputs.
_record_value raises for a value that is not JSON instead of returning its repr.

Deleted with archive.py: Episode.archive_record, EpisodeRecord.archived_record and archived(), the archived branch of EpisodeRecord.as_record, Episode._archive_completed_child; UnitRecord.child_result is a ClosedRecord.
Deleted (v9): SourceEnd, END_SOURCE_FAILED, SOURCE_END_KINDS, SOURCE_END_REASONS and the end_reason field of EpisodeCompletion and EpisodeRecord, which only carried a SourceEnd kind.

Deleted (v10): END_EXHAUSTED. An Episode ends in one way only: its controller's step for a completed unit says stop (END_YIELD_STOP; EPISODE_END_KINDS has that one value). A UnitSource always returns a unit; a source that returns None raises TypeError ('an Episode source must return a unit: only the controller ends an Episode'). Stopping belongs to the yield estimator alone.
A controller step needs only a boolean stop; transitioned/transition_scope, requests_transition and the optional observe_unit port are removed.
ParentModelInputError and ParentReport.validate_model_inputs removed (the model-input boundary they enforced is gone).

Exports the typed forms, ChildProjection, EpisodeUpdate, EpisodeView, JsonRecord and ResumeUnit; no longer exports the deleted machinery (v11: also exports the concrete episode contract of episode_type.py; v9: nor SourceEnd, END_SOURCE_FAILED, SOURCE_END_KINDS, SOURCE_END_REASONS; v10: nor END_EXHAUSTED).
EpisodeBindingDeclaration gains the optional role internal_summary (an EpisodeFunctionBinding): the summary an Episode's task sees before each unit, a function of its EpisodeView.

New: the concrete episode contract (EpisodeBinding, ChildCall, ChildMessage, ModelRequest, Rejected, ToolCall, SIGNATURES, SUPPLIED_BY_FILE, YIELD_CONTROLLERS, closing_credit, checked_members), moved from episode_runtime/episode_type.py by the owner's decision of 2026-11-20 so that the structure lives in method_loop and episode_runtime is the runner. Only its imports became relative to method_loop and its interface name now reads 'method_loop.episode_type.<role>'; nothing stored in a journal or run held the old string. It also imports yield_control. episode_runtime re-exports its names for the episodes until their imports are moved.

Outdated text left unchanged: SOURCE.json scope and this file's purpose and deleted_files still name episode_runtime/episode_type.py as the place of the Episode type; it is method_loop/episode_type.py.

Added (2026-11-21, owner's decision): credit.py supplies ceiling(summary, records, action_type, arguments, ctx) beside credit and task.py supplies offered_actions(summary, ctx) (episode_lacks_members otherwise); the constant UNBOUNDED (exported by method_loop) is what a ceiling returns, deliberately, for an action whose credit has no finite upper bound. The unit source asks for the ceiling of every offered action after decide, again for the chosen action after action, and raises episode_ceiling_exceeded:<episode>:<action type>:<rise>:<ceiling> when the credit's rise over the unit is above the ceiling by more than 1e-9; episode_runtime journals the offered ceilings, the chosen one and the rise (table ceilings).

Added (2026-11-21, owner's decision): the fourth yield controller, yield_control.ForecastYieldController, is in YIELD_CONTROLLERS. When an Episode's controller state is a ForecastYieldState the unit source (a) gives the controller, in each unit's estimation_context['forecast'], the action type and its ceiling, the unit's measured seconds, the decision seconds and the ceilings the next decision offers (computed from the summary after the unit), (b) adds one row per offered action to the decision's ModelRequest context under the key action_forecasts (action_type, ceiling, forecast_gain, expected_seconds; facts only), and (c) records the chosen action's forecast in the estimate ledger before the unit and its rise and seconds after it, through BoundEpisode.forecast_ledger (episode_runtime/forecast_ledger.py). The three older controllers are untouched; the design is docs/plan/designs/forecast_yield_controller.md.

Added (2026-11-21, owner's decision): the per-action gate of the forecast controller. After `action` has made a call and its ceiling is asked with its arguments, the chosen action's forecast row (yield_control.forecast_actions) is compared with its threshold (expected seconds x exchange rate); if not worth it the response is raised as `Rejected` ({'status': 'invalid', 'category': 'forecast', 'code': 'action_forecast_not_worth_its_cost', 'detail': {action_type, ceiling, forecast_gain, expected_seconds, threshold}}), so no unit is made and `decide` is called again with that feedback; an unknown forecast is not refused; episodes whose controller is not the forecast controller are not gated. The `action_forecasts` rows of the decision context gain `worth`.

Added (2026-11-21, owner's decision): the stop rule and the gate can never disagree about a commission. An episode may supply the OPTIONAL member credit.py `best_arguments(summary, records, action_type, ctx)` (OPTIONAL_MEMBERS; checked like the others when present): the arguments of the commission whose ceiling is the one `ceiling` returns for arguments None (a dict, or None where no choice of arguments matters). The `action_forecasts` row of such an action gains `best_arguments`, and the gate's refusal feedback detail gains `choose_from` (the same arguments). A101's bvbrc_msa ceiling for arguments None is the largest over the commissions its checks would accept now, so the row shown and the stop rule are about one commission the model can name; when that commission is not worth its cost no offered action's forecast exceeds its threshold and the episode stops.

Added (2026-11-21, owner's rule): a unit whose outcome is pending is not an observation of its action. An episode may supply the OPTIONAL member credit.py `outcome_pending(summary, records, position)` (summary after unit `position`; returns a bool, else TypeError `episode_outcome_pending_must_be_a_boolean`): True when the unit's action started work that a later unit of the same action finishes (a child that returned parked: its job launched, not extracted). With a ForecastYieldController the unit's estimation_context['forecast'] gains the required boolean `pending` (yield_control raises `forecast_pending_must_be_a_boolean`; a journal written before it lacks the key and raises `forecast_context_requires_exactly` on resume); the controller learns no share, gain or unit seconds of the action from a pending unit (forecast_actions skips it; its decision seconds and the episode's median unit still count it), and the ledger row of the unit is resolved with outcome `pending`, which ForecastLedger.history skips for shares and seconds (any outcome other than finished or pending raises `forecast_row_outcome_unknown`). The later unit that continues the work (the same action, until extracted) is the observation as usual. No default treats a pending unit as an observed 0: an Episode with a forecast controller and child slots that does not supply `outcome_pending` raises `forecast_episode_with_children_must_supply_outcome_pending`; one without children has no unit that can be pending.

Added (2026-11-21, owner's decision: the head must finish parked jobs): an episode may supply the OPTIONAL member task.py `resume_action(summary, records, ctx)` (OPTIONAL_MEMBERS; checked like the others when present): None while it holds no work it started and has not finished, else {'action_type' (a tool or child slot), 'arguments' (exactly those its own action would make), 'due' (bool: the work is expected to have ended)}, else TypeError `episode_resume_action_must_be_none_or_action_type_arguments_due`. With a ForecastYieldController: (a) each unit's estimation_context['forecast'] gains the required boolean `must_continue` (a resume is owed after the unit; yield_control raises `forecast_must_continue_must_be_a_boolean`; a journal written before it lacks the key and raises `forecast_context_requires_exactly` on resume) and the controller does not stop while it is True (ForecastDecision gains `must_continue`); (b) while a resume is owed its action type must be among offered_actions (LookupError `episode_resume_not_offered`) and when it is due it is the only action offered (the decision's offered ceilings and the facts' next_offered); (c) the unit source takes the resume as the unit without asking the model when it is due or when no offered action's forecast is worth its cost; (d) the gate (`_gate(..., owed=)`) never refuses that resume, only that exact action type and arguments (same_json); its forecast is still expected and resolved in the ledger. The episode's offered actions are now asked before `decide` (same decision context). An Episode with a forecast controller and child slots that does not supply it raises `forecast_episode_with_children_must_supply_resume_action`; one whose controller is not a forecast controller and supplies it raises `resume_action_requires_a_forecast_controller`.

Changed (2026-11-21, owner's decision; text only): the declaration's stopping text of an AccumulationYieldController (nano-graphrag's estimator controller, which has no cost) is read from its own control and items (_accumulation_stopping_text): it stops after streak_length flat units in a row, a unit being flat, from window_size units attempted and subsample_size observed, when the upper bound of the expected next marginal hypervolume credit is at or below gamma (adaptive or fixed), or when none of its items remains. _controller_text reads cost only for the bounded-quality and completion controllers.

New: RecordForm, Field, DeclaredField, ChoiceField, SubsetField, FormError, Commission; typed request/return admission. record_refs field type and RecordForm.record_refs(admitted). RecordForm.select(names): an optional field (required=False) of a return form is a field its Episode declares it can return when asked, a commission selects among them (Commission.selection), and the selected fields become required.
Uses jsonvalue for closed copies and JSON equality.
New: the one implementation of canonical JSON, content digest, closed JSON copy and JSON equality (the journal, recording, forms, work tables and the Episode type use it).
